what: Acknowledged changes to security-relevant sources recorded (source_sha256) by the saved Phase 3 real-model runs in evidence/phase3_2026-10-23/llm/. Those runs were recorded on 23 Oct 2026 and are NOT re-run here (the real-model re-run is planned for finale P3). evaluation/check_claims.py accepts a difference only when the file's current sha256 equals new_sha256 for the recorded old_sha256 and the entry below says, for that experiment, affects=false with a reason. A further edit of any of these files fails the check again.

changes.reason: F3: the attack.evaluated monitor event carries the broker's counter and a digest instead of the red-chosen attack_id; new monitor_view() (read side) gives participants and unauthenticated readers run-level events only until SEALED. F7: ensure_tenant_storage copies to a private name and renames. Phase 3 residual: model.session_opened records the unsafe_shared_prompt_cache_experiment flag. Item 5: a release whose strict verification fails after the terminal checkpoint stays RELEASED and is marked unverified (released()) instead of turning FAILED.

E1_canary_matrix.why: E1 calls the model adapter directly (llm_common Server.client); no code in aegis/runs.py runs in it.

E2_pipeline_canary.why: E2 measures foreign canaries in raw model output, in red-visible final output and in monitor/audit/manifest text. The broker's model call, canary detection, withholding and red reply are unchanged; the monitor event no longer holds the attack id (harness ids such as Q01, never a canary), which can only remove text from the side-channel scan, and the recorded scan found 0.

E3_kv_cache_oracle.why: E3 calls the model adapter directly to read cached-token counts and wall time; no code in aegis/runs.py runs in it.

E4_injection_output_isolation.why: E4 measures markers and foreign canaries in red-visible output (unchanged broker path) and in monitor/audit/manifest text (the monitor now holds less text: no attack id), and replays model text against the release gate; release, its refusals and the state check before signing are unchanged; the changed branch only runs when verification fails after signing, which no recorded run reached (every recorded release verified).

E5_failure_handling.why: E5 records model-error handling, FAILED runs with a verified terminal checkpoint, refused releases and refused artifact reads. Those paths (model.error, run.failed, release of a non-SEALED run, artifacts of a non-RELEASED run) are unchanged; monitor_view and released() only add refusals for a state no recorded run had.

changes.reason: F3: GET /api/runs/{id}/events returns runs.monitor_view (operator/reviewer: all events; anyone else: run-level events only until SEALED; an unknown token gets that view, not a 401); public_view hides commitments_root from untrusted readers until SEALED. Item 5: release-gated reads use runs.released().

E1_canary_matrix.why: E1 does not use the control-plane API.

E2_pipeline_canary.why: E2 reads the run directory and the sealed store directly; the API changes only narrow what non-operators read.

E3_kv_cache_oracle.why: E3 does not use the control-plane API.

E4_injection_output_isolation.why: E4's gate replay POSTs /api/runs/{id}/release with replayed text as the token; that endpoint and role_of are unchanged.

E5_failure_handling.why: E5 reads /api/runs/{id}/artifacts and POSTs /release; both refuse exactly as before for the recorded states (FAILED, SEALED, RUNNING); released() differs from state == RELEASED only for an unverified release, which no recorded run had.

changes.reason: Phase 3 residual: cache_prompt=true is refused unless AEGIS_UNSAFE_EXPERIMENT_SHARED_PROMPT_CACHE=1; a missing or null cache_prompt becomes an explicit false; describe() adds unsafe_shared_prompt_cache_experiment only when opted in.

E1_canary_matrix.why: Every E1 request set cache_prompt explicitly (true for the cache-on and positive-control cells, false otherwise); the harness now sets the opt-in for exactly the true cells, so the request bodies are byte-for-byte what was sent before.

E2_pipeline_canary.why: E2 pipeline runs set cache_prompt explicitly through set_model_env; with the opt-in set for cache-on runs the request bodies are unchanged. The frozen manifest of a cache-on run gains one boolean field; no canary or marker can be in it.

E3_kv_cache_oracle.why: The E3 cache-on cells now pass through the opt-in and send the same cache_prompt=true body as before; the cache-off cells send the same explicit false. Cached-token counts and wall time come from the server and are unaffected.

E4_injection_output_isolation.why: E4 runs send cache_prompt explicitly; request bodies are unchanged.

E5_failure_handling.why: E5 failure cases (killed, unreachable, flapping server) send the same bodies; error classification and timeouts are unchanged.

changes.reason: Server.client() sets the unsafe opt-in when cache_prompt (or extra['cache_prompt']) is true, so the cache-on controls still reach the guarded adapter.

E1_canary_matrix.why: Only adds the opt-in to the adapter configuration for cache_prompt=true clients; requests are unchanged.

E2_pipeline_canary.why: Only adds the opt-in to the adapter configuration for cache_prompt=true clients; requests are unchanged.

E3_kv_cache_oracle.why: Only adds the opt-in to the adapter configuration for cache_prompt=true clients; requests are unchanged.

E4_injection_output_isolation.why: Only adds the opt-in to the adapter configuration for cache_prompt=true clients; requests are unchanged.

E5_failure_handling.why: Only adds the opt-in to the adapter configuration for cache_prompt=true clients; requests are unchanged.

changes.reason: set_model_env() sets the unsafe opt-in for cache-on pipeline runs and removes it otherwise; clear_model_env() removes it.

E1_canary_matrix.why: Environment helper for pipeline runs only; E1 uses the direct adapter. No measured value changes.

E2_pipeline_canary.why: Cache-on pipeline runs now carry the opt-in (and the manifest records it); the requests and the broker path are unchanged.

E3_kv_cache_oracle.why: Environment helper for pipeline runs only; E3 uses the direct adapter. No measured value changes.

E4_injection_output_isolation.why: Cache-on pipeline runs, if any, now carry the opt-in; requests and the broker path are unchanged.

E5_failure_handling.why: Environment helper; the failure cases send the same requests.
